player.hud.exit.description: Accessible name of a declared player HUD control that leaves playback (a back chevron).

player.hud.more.description: Label of the player HUD's More pill, which opens the player menu.

player.hud.play_pause.description: Label for a declared player HUD pill or button that toggles playback; stable wording so its measured width does not change when paused.

player.hud.seek_back_caption.description: Read-out inside the player's skip-back disc: the interval it jumps, in whole seconds; keep it short.

player.hud.seek_forward_caption.description: Read-out inside the player's skip-forward disc: the interval it jumps, in whole seconds; keep it short.

player.hud.skip_back.description: Label for a declared player HUD pill or button that seeks backward; the command owns the interval.

player.hud.skip_forward.description: Label for a declared player HUD pill or button that seeks forward; the command owns the interval.

player.stream.app_audio.value: decoded by MultiPlex and sent to the TV as PCM
player.stream.app_audio.description: Note in the player's playback details panel, lower case, no final period: the app decodes the sound itself.

player.stream.audio.description: Heading of the sound lines in the player's playback details panel (the ⓘ disc): shown in capitals; one word.

player.stream.output.description: A line of the player's playback details panel: what reaches the screen or the receiver (e.g. '720p SDR'). Keep the value last.

player.stream.server_audio.description: Note in the player's playback details panel, lower case, no final period: the Plex server converts the sound for this TV.

player.stream.source.description: A line of the player's playback details panel: what the file itself carries (e.g. '1080p HDR'). Keep the value last.

player.stream.to_sdr.description: Note in the player's playback details panel, lower case, no final period (the app adds them): the server converted the HDR picture to SDR. {source} is a picture format such as 'HDR' or 'Dolby Vision'.

player.stream.transcode_note.value: the server converts the video for this TV
player.stream.transcode_note.description: Note in the player's playback details panel, lower case, no final period: why the picture is not the original file.

player.stream.transcoding.description: Short pill in the player: the Plex server is converting the video for this TV.

player.stream.tv_audio.value: decoded by the TV, or passed as is to your receiver
player.stream.tv_audio.description: Note in the player's playback details panel, lower case, no final period: the TV decodes the sound itself, or sends it untouched to an amplifier; the app cannot tell which.

player.stream.unsure_note.value: items marked “?” cannot be checked on this TV: the TV or the receiver decides
player.stream.unsure_note.description: Note in the player's playback details panel, lower case, no final period: what the question mark on a pill means.

player.stream.video.description: Heading of the picture lines in the player's playback details panel (the ⓘ disc): shown in capitals; one word.

player.up_next.seconds_left.description: The Play Next button label with whole seconds remaining for a declared numeric HUD countdown; all values are measured before layout.
